segments.name: Wireless
segments.description: Provides wireless telecommunications services to Canadian consumers, businesses, the public sector, and wholesale providers.
segments.evidence: Wireless telecommunications operations for Canadian consumers, businesses, the public sector, and wholesale providers.

segments.name: Cable
products: network connectivity through our fibre network
segments.description: Provides cable telecommunications and connectivity services supporting voice, data, networking, hosting, and cloud-based services to Canadian consumers, businesses, and wholesale markets.
segments.evidence: Cable telecommunications operations, including Internet, television and other video (Video), Satellite, telephony (Home Phone), and home monitoring services for Canadian consumers and businesses, and network connectivity through our fibre network to support a range of voice, data, networking, hosting, and cloud-based services for the business, public sector, and carrier wholesale markets.

segments.name: Media
segments.description: Operates a diversified portfolio of media properties including sports and entertainment, broadcasting, digital media, and sports team ownership.
segments.evidence: A diversified portfolio of media properties, including sports media and entertainment, television and radio broadcasting, specialty channels, digital media, and sports team ownership.

revenueModel.text: Canadian consumers, businesses, public sector, and wholesale providers pay Rogers for wireless and cable telecommunications services, while advertisers, fans, and audiences pay for media content, broadcasts, and game-related items.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue recognized, and the related costs incurred, on game-related items (tickets, merchandise, and concessions, for example) and advertising is concentrated when games are played, with postseason games commanding a premium in advertising revenue and additional revenue from game-related items, if and when any of the teams play in their respective postseasons.

changes.text: In 2025, Today's Shopping Choice (TSC) was transferred from the Media reportable segment to Corporate Items.
changes.evidence: Effective this year, Today's Shopping Choice (TSC) was transferred from the Media reportable segment to Corporate Items, consistent with changes to its management structure.

changes.text: In 2023, Rogers completed its acquisition of Shaw Communications Inc.
changes.evidence: References in these financial statements to the Shaw Transaction are to our acquisition of Shaw Communications Inc. (Shaw) on April 3, 2023.
